movements.review: Horizontal bench, separate pronated dumbbells, realistic full figure; framing corrected.
Approved original immutable control specimen
Head below hips, ankle rollers grounded and decline geometry explicit.
Foot-end view clearly exposes neutral palms-in grips and head-to-foot dumbbell axes; elbows tucked.
Upper arms/head/back grounded, knees bent, no bench; complete shoes now visible.
Round dumbbells visibly compressed together with controlled press; distinct contact cue. Squeeze/Hex are overlapping catalog identities, not invented different mechanics.
Four separate hex heads and two handles with visible central contact seam; corrected fused equipment. Graphite hex heads remain realistic and neutral.
Open fly arc with light weights and softly bent elbows differs visibly from press; horizontal support and complete limbs.
Inclined backrest and open softly bent fly arc clear; both weights and feet in frame; matches original material/light.
Head-low decline and ankle rollers explicit; wide fly arc with restrained elbow bend; complete dumbbells.
Complete bar sleeves and shoes now visible; floor support and symmetric load preserved.
Characteristic near-chest suspended bar and flat bench preserved; full shoes and sleeve now inside frame. A still cannot prove pause duration.
Both legs extended and floating without leg drive, horizontal bench and symmetric straight loaded bar; complete silhouette visible.
Flat bench, wide pronated grip and flared bent elbows place bar over upper chest/neck line; framing correction retains lowered phase and both shoes. Skin, floor and restrained rim match original.
Visible underhand grip and tucked elbows, flat bench and balanced bar; full figure/implement. Far shoe clearance is tight but intact.
Correct raised central camber with lower outer handgrips and symmetric plate loads; unwanted rack removed without changing bar geometry. Full bench athlete and sleeve ends retained.
Plate visibly grounded on upper back; straight plank, bent elbows and planted hands/toes; full figure and clear free-weight identity.
Near-upright supported seated overhead press, two intact dumbbells and planted feet; chest mark removed. Top margin remains modest but all equipment is inside square.
Standing overhead press with stable torso/legs and no bench; coherent athlete/style and full weights/shoes.
Supinated palms-in start, forward elbows and upright seated posture clearly distinguish Arnold rotation start; credible overlapping separate dumbbells.
Both arms raised forward to shoulder height with pronated grips and soft elbows; full standing figure, four distinct dumbbell heads, no incline-pose contamination.
One arm at shoulder height forward while opposite dumbbell rests by thigh, communicating alternating phase distinctly from bilateral front raise; full figure and equipment.
One plate gripped at opposite edges, forward shoulder-height arms and intact standing silhouette. Plate hole and two hands visible.
Short straight loaded bar with pronated grip, arms projecting forward rather than elbows leading upright row. Complete bar and athlete.
Framing edit keeps bilateral press mechanics and continuous bar while restoring full grounded pivot base with visible left margin.
Clear half-kneeling stance with grounded knee and opposite foot, both hands at sleeve end, continuous anchored bar and secured plate; whole support visible.
Single arm pressing sleeve with other hand empty at hip, staggered standing base and continuous bar to floor pivot; tight but intact anchor and hand margins.
Unsupported upright floor-seated torso, extended legs/heels and overhead bar clearly identify Z Press; symmetric realistic bar and full shoes.
Rear three-quarter shows bar just above/behind crown with elbows bent, not overhead lockout; representative Bradford transfer phase. Entire equipment and figure fit.
Full standing T silhouette, soft elbows, pronated/neutral wrist rotation and two intact light dumbbells; lateral rather than forward arm plane.
Upright seat contact, planted feet and wide lateral arms distinguish from standing and pressing; complete flat bench and both weights.
Inclined back support with pronated hands and sideways abduction corrected the fly-like first attempt; soft elbows, complete bench and planted feet.
Feet now beside support, rigid body inclines away, supporting arm extended toward post, one free dumbbell lateral. Full capped post and base retained.
Side-lying on horizontal bench, stacked legs and supported lower elbow, one raised upper arm in lateral plane. Four limbs, grounded support and full shoe edges.

Prone chest contact and wide arm abduction distinguish from supine supported raise. Actual incline is steeper than prompt but remains valid chest-supported setup; intact bilateral dumbbells and grounded feet.
Controlled low partial abduction with hands below ribs, not shoulder-height full raise; intact bilateral dumbbells, relaxed shoulder position, complete standing figure.
Both plate surfaces now have no letters or numbers; wide overhead lateral arc, full feet/hands, consistent original studio treatment.
Two distinct dumbbells close to lower chest, wrists below bent outward/upward elbows; clear upright-row mechanics and full body.
Wide pronated grip outside shoulder line, bar close to torso and elbows above wrists; symmetric light loading and complete bar/feet.
Narrow pronated bar grip with tucked elbows on flat bench, grounded feet and full compact rack; distinct from wide chest pressing. Complete equipment despite tighter sleeve/shoe margins.

Side view now shows upper arms angled toward feet, raised elbows and forearms folding back/down toward chin; bar at chin transition rather than forehead extension. Pronated separated grips, natural occlusion of far arm, whole athlete/bench/bar. Distinct JM transition with safe facial clearance.
Elbows now flexed with straight bar above forehead and no head contact; full shoes restored. Recognizable lying elbow-extension phase rather than press lockout.
Characteristic bent-elbow EZ extension over forehead, symmetric bent grip shaft and complete athlete/shoe framing; distinct implement from straight-bar version.
Framing restores far shoe while keeping deep elbow hinge, neutral grips and two separate dumbbells beside head. Natural overlap, no bar/face intersection.
Inclined backrest with elbows flexed and EZ bar behind crown, distinguishable from flat versions. Real bench support and complete shoes, same original studio.
True head-low decline with secured feet, EZ bar behind forehead and deep elbow hinge. Whole bench, bar and shoes remain visible; original studio/skin/metal treatment retained.
Seated upright two-hand cupped upper dumbbell head, both elbows overhead and single vertical weight behind crown. Full seat, athlete, weight and shoes.
Standing unilateral extension with one hand at handle behind head, other arm empty, elbow overhead; complete figure and weight, distinct rear camera.
Dumbbell lower heads at upper chest, elbows flared and above wrists, forearms folding inward; distinct Tate bottom position. Matched dumbbell heads, complete shoes and flat bench in perspective.
Neutral dumbbells rolled behind crown with upper arms angled back and deep elbow flexion. Both shoes complete; characteristic behind-head transition, temporal roll cannot be proved by still.
Far shoe fully restored; one dumbbell cupped by two hands behind crown with bent elbows and upper arms traveling back. Complete bench/athlete and original style retained.
